hero.text: A foster home. A little patience. A whole community behind one cat’s next chapter. That is the heart of Feline Fairies.

why.quote: A safe place to land can change a cat’s whole world.
why.text: Feline Fairies is a volunteer-run nonprofit based in St. Augustine, Florida. Through foster homes, basic medical care, and adoption, we help homeless and vulnerable cats find a path to loving families.

paragraphs: Our cats stay in volunteer foster homes. A familiar space and daily care give each cat room to settle in, while fosters help us learn their individual personalities and needs.
That knowledge guides thoughtful connections with adopters and makes every new home possible.
model.statement: Care begins with a safe place to land.

beginning.title: Small beginnings. Shared purpose.
beginning.text: Feline Fairies began with volunteers helping kittens in need. It has grown through neighbors who foster, volunteer, adopt, and give, while remaining a community-driven rescue serving St. Augustine and North Florida.

help.title: Every helping hand matters.
help.text: Give a cat a home, share your time, or help meet the everyday needs of cats in foster care.
